create_2sat_problem: create a randomly generated 2-sat bipartite graph problem with specified literal range
train_gnn_2sat: train a graph neural network to solve 2-satisfiability problems using message passing
define_gnn_network: define a graph neural network with interaction network message passing steps
build_2sat_solver: build a 2-sat solver that trains a GNN on randomly generated satisfiability problems
run_2sat_training: run the 2-sat solver training with configurable steps and logging
